𝗘𝗡𝗚𝗟𝗔𝗡𝗗 𝟯𝟮𝟴 𝗔𝗟𝗟 𝗢𝗨𝗧! 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁥󠁮󠁧󠁿

Duckett's 133 lifts England to 328 in 48.3 overs in the Hobart decider.
Australia need 329 to take the series.

Can they chase it? 👇

#AUSvENG #Cricket

👉 Hobart ke decider mein Ben Duckett ne 133 runon ki shaandaar pari kheli
👉 England 48.3 overs mein 328 pe all out
👉 Australia ko series jeetne ke liye 329 chahiye

Kya Australia chase kar paayegi? Comment karo 👇

#CricketKiBaat #AUSvENG #Cricket
